炭酸飲料はなぜ開けると泡が出る？――圧力が変えるCO₂の居場所

A Japanese-English mixed explanation of why carbonated drinks fizz after opening. It follows dissolved CO₂ from high-pressure equilibrium through pressure release, supersaturation, nucleation, bubble growth, temperature effects, shaken bottles, Mentos, and the distinction between CO₂(aq) and true carbonic acid.
